crossRefs.note: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass…

parallels.note: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor…

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Zippor
people.line: Father of Balak, king of Moab

translations.web: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,
translations.bsb: And Balaam said to God, “Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent me this message:
translations.kjv: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent
translations.asv: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,
